figures.caption: FIG. 2. (a) S21 from DL4c with kSAW¼ 4 lm and VDC1 ¼ 30 V and different values of VDC2, with a 10 dB offset between adjacent curves. Black arrow indicates the fslow mode. (b) S21max as a function of VDC2. (c) S21max decaying with time after zeroing VDC1 and VDC2 from 30 V. The initial response is fitted to an exponential decay S21max ¼ Ae−t=s with A ¼ −50:763 dBm and s ¼ 55:88 s. (d) Time-domain echoes of S21 from DL4c with 250 kSAW delay at VDC1¼ VDC2¼ 30 V. Peak values are fitted to a straight line to extract c listed in Table I.
